original.statement: Istio now bypasses the overload manager for static listeners; setting env var BYPASS_OVERLOAD_MANAGER_FOR_STATIC_LISTENERS to false in the agent Deployment reverts this.

corrected.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds the agent env var BYPASS_OVERLOAD_MANAGER_FOR_STATIC_LISTENERS (effectively true), so static listeners bypass the overload manager; setting it to false in the agent Deployment reverts this.

decision.reason: [ev-0f35637a9823] says the overload-manager bypass for static listeners was added and can be turned off by setting BYPASS_OVERLOAD_MANAGER_FOR_STATIC_LISTENERS to false. That supports an env-var with change type "added", and an effective value of true, since false is what reverts it. The same text says the variable is set "in agent Deployment", which names the agent as the component that owns it, so the subject should include component "agent".
